title: Pin shared CI images and define upgrade policy
context: Replace the mutable `docker.io/gardusi-gustavo/ci:1` dependency with an explicit version

spec.summary: Pin shared CI images and define upgrade policy
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The policy is written and linked from the images docs.
Every consumer CI image uses the chosen reference.
The publish workflow records the digest.
An upgrade requires a deliberate change and passes CI.
No consumer silently follows a mutable tag.
A changed shared image does not alter consumers until they update.
